verdict.rationale: The axis applies: a law firm with an employment practice could plausibly prepare hiring paperwork. However, the pack contains no evidence that Bird & Bird drafts offer letters, employment agreements, or invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements. The closest item covers advice on employee incentives (EMI, share options), which is an adjacent employment topic and not hiring documentation, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm prepares hiring paperwork — offer letters, employment agreements, and invention-assignment/confidentiality agreements — as part of a documented employment practice
